issue.title: Nightly APK blocked by online expo-doctor; Slack mislabels failures as skipped
issue.body:
## Problem

After #484 simplified nightly to one cron + same-run Slack, scheduled Nightly Preview runs (Sep 13–17) still produce **no APK** and Slack posts **“Fluent nightly skipped (no APK)”** even though the workflow failed before EAS.

**Evidence**

| Date | Actions run | Commit | Failed step | EAS |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sep 13–17 | e.g. [35167024644](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/actions/runs/35167024644) | various | **Expo doctor** | skipped |
| Last real nightly APK | — | `c39799d` | — | EAS `9cab7d4d` (Sep 11) |

Adjacent Expo dashboard rows that look like “double builds” are **`preview` profile**, not `nightly`.

**Root causes**

1. Nightly runs online `expo-doctor` **without** `EXPO_DOCTOR_SKIP_DEPENDENCY_VERSION_CHECK`, violating the two-clock model (`docs/ci.md` / #422). Upstream Expo 57.0.x patch freshness fails CI with no repo diff.
2. `expo-sdk-align.yml` cannot open its rolling PR — `EXPO_SDK_ALIGN_APP_ID` / `EXPO_SDK_ALIGN_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` / `EXPO_SDK_ALIGN_TOKEN` are missing (ops follow-up).
3. Slack `STATUS=failure` is titled/copy as “skipped (no APK)” and `FAILED_STEP` is the job name, not the real step (e.g. Expo doctor).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Nightly Expo validation matches Quality Gates: skip remote dep-version check + warn on network errors; offline `expo:check` before EAS
- [ ] Online patch freshness remains only on `expo-sdk-align.yml`
- [ ] Slack outcomes are mutually exclusive and truthful: success (build id + install URL), skipped (no new commits), failed before APK (named step), EAS build failed
- [ ] Failure Slack never claims “no APK” after a successful EAS step in the same run
- [ ] Tests cover Slack copy + workflow contract (deterministic doctor env, offline check, one cron, no pending-delivery job)
- [ ] Docs (`docs/ci.md`, QA preview guide, `.github/README.md`) distinguish skip vs pre-EAS fail vs EAS fail

## Out of scope (ops follow-up)

- Configuring Expo SDK Align GitHub App / PAT secrets (cannot ship secrets in code)

## Related

- #484 / #517 — simplify nightly schedule
- #422 — two-clock Expo health
- #459 / #462 — delayed cron trust
